scope: Control-design alignment: static gravity attitude initialization, radio-loss response, launch-to-landing handover, telemetry and regression
changes: When radio validity expires after 300 ms, an active controller with valid vertical state requests the normal controlled-landing path and latches link_lost_landing for telemetry.

During blind-zone launch, radio loss only uses the monotonic ground-launch fade when fresh raw ToF confirms near ground; without vertical or near-ground evidence it reports CL_LINK_LOST and zeros output rather than claiming a controlled landing.
A landing request from launch with valid range captures the actually emitted mixer mean for a bumpless transition. This is a transition reference only, not a learned hover-throttle estimate.

Three-pass review found that an intentional landing request during blind-zone CL_LAUNCH starts the bounded thrust fade without near-ground evidence; unlike the radio-loss path, it cannot prove the aircraft is still on the ground. This remains a pre-flight blocker and is documented without changing flight behavior in this review.

Attitude startup now waits for a stable 40-sample gravity window and initializes the body-to-NED quaternion from mean specific force; unstable/inverted starts remain invalid. This is a static alignment gate, not a complete dynamic acceleration classifier.

Design notes now distinguish implemented behavior from target behavior: no accelerometer bias estimate, adaptive vibration confidence, nonzero rate D, mixer saturation feedback, thrust calibration, inertial-flow fusion or relative-position hold is claimed.
Critical IMU, ToF, timing and output faults retain their existing fault-stop behavior; HOVER_STOP remains the immediate stop command.
JP13 closed-loop telemetry includes link_lost_land; design, project status and historical tethered-flight notes were updated.

three_pass_review.focus: 逐条对照控制方案的传感融合、分段控制与状态转换
three_pass_review.result: 与本轮实现一致；设计中尚未实现的项目仍明确标为未完成
checked: 稳定40样本平均重力初始化机体到NED四元数；姿态环始终运行；首个有效ToF后即启用垂直修正，8cm仅作起飞阶段/光流距离判据
光流仅在距离、质量和标定有效时渐进参与横向速度阻尼
有效高度下的遥控失联进入正常下降；遥控失联发生在盲区启动时，只有新鲜近地原始ToF才能走地面取消渐停
设计目标和当前实现已分开说明：静态姿态门、短时互补高度估计和速度阻尼存在；动态加速度可信度、KF偏置/协方差、推力标定和相对位置控制仍是缺口
open_gaps: 静止重力门限不能排除恒定线加速度，且门限未用真实振动/启动记录验证
高度观察器仍是短时互补估计，不是带偏置和协方差的三状态KF；固定ToF创新门限未整定，也未扣安装高度d0
加速度零偏/自适应振动权重、非零角速度D和混控饱和反馈未实现；光流比例/旋转补偿没有实测标定，悬停推力及动态PID没有飞行整定

three_pass_review.focus: 复核状态边界、重复事件、故障优先级和急停语义
three_pass_review.result: 回归覆盖的边界通过；未验证的传感器失效边界保留为飞行阻塞
checked: 持续失联不会反复重置降落计时；无线恢复或新的START不会恢复旧飞行，需STOP后新START
正常降落的触地末段渐停需要新鲜原始5至39mm状态正常读数；融合高度无效本身不能触发。已确认代码差异：盲区CL_LAUNCH时操作者主动取消会不经近地证据直接启动0.20 duty/s减推力，失联分支则要求新鲜近地证据；前者不能证明飞机仍在地面，列为飞行前阻塞
IMU、ToF超时、倾角、时序和输出故障仍走故障关断；HOVER_STOP仍是立即停机
open_gaps: ToF完全失联且惯性延拓过期时仍会故障归零；尚无经过验证的空中降级方案
盲区启动且融合高度无效时，主动降落/取消命令会无近地证据直接渐停；首次有效ToF前若已离地，可能空中减推力。与要求新鲜近地证据的失联处理不同，该分支须在动力飞行前修正或完成专门验证
正常降落、遥控失联降落及软着陆均未做硬件或飞行验收

remaining_blockers: A total ToF loss or expired inertial height estimate still faults to zero output; no unvalidated fixed-throttle fallback was added.
The short height observer is not the proposed three-state covariance filter and has no synchronized high-rate sensor replay or tuned innovation noise.
Attitude gains, thrust margin, flow calibration, link-loss landing and normal landing have no dynamic flight acceptance.
Hardware tethered-flight profiles remain locked after the reported frame damage.
